review.official:
R&V Model witchcraft operation platform PhonoR-0,
Rhodes Island
's first and only intelligent operation platform equipped with a
Banshee
incantation
Arts
device. Unlike the customized
Raythean Industries
models, she was born from the unbreakable rapport between our most skilled operators and the Banshees. Compared to other wheeled operation platforms, the witchcraft-based components in her operating mechanisms, drive system, and core more closely resemble a mobile altar. Despite being the product of both cutting-edge technology and
Sarkaz
witchcraft, her basic specs are unimpressive, but she is easy to deploy and able to provide mid-mission assistance to operators. She currently participates in combat missions as a Supporter Operator.

files.description:
[Top Speed] 22km/h
[Climb] Normal
[Brake] Normal
[Mobility] Normal
[Endurance] Standard
[Structural Integrity] Standard

After PhonoR-0 was formally inducted as a member of Rhodes Island, some elite operators aware of the situation made bets in private. They were curious as to how much this emissary of the Banshees would affect Logos's personal life. There were also busybodies like Closure who took an interest in the former Great Banshee. After all, 'sending one's voice over' was seen as an incredibly strange act to other Sarkaz. In the end, though, nothing really changed. Logos paid no heed to the unusual 'elder' often by his side. At times, they would go on walks on the deck together. While Rhodes Island was preparing to leave Londinium, PhonoR-0 proved to be a big help in our final few operations. She even accepted being the subject of Closure's research without hesitation. Whenever she heard amusing anecdotes about Logos from other operators, she would politely ask them to repeat themselves slowly so she could record their stories and send them back to the Convallis of the Banshees. On occasion, and only on occasion, operators having a few drinks at Just One More Pint would notice that PhonoR-0 had replaced the usual jukebox. Most times, she would simply quietly emit a red light while playing gentle melodies the operators at the bar had never heard. But whenever Logos came by, a melodious Banshee chant would find itself on the playlist. Her voice sounds as though it comes from the other side of this great land, passing through the Convallis and the crystal arches studded across the earth. It was not long before she received an invitation to join Rhodes Island's choir.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Please do not feel anxious, Doctor. You're not a person with a chaotic mind. The order in your life does not always manifest as an organized external environment. Therefore, I respect your preference for a cluttered personal space.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, my sound may closely mirror that of Laqeramaline, but I'm not her. The Banshees just want to express their longing for Aefanyl in her utterance. They also hope that when he comes to miss his home, his mother's voice will be there to answer him.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The lace veil on the table? It was a gift that my sisters knitted for me the first time I returned to the Convallis. It is embroidered with a blessed incantation, capable of greatly amplifying the potency of Arts on the battlefield, and serving as a dust cover in times of peace.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Doctor, my predecessor was an Arts device carrying a protective incantation. It was Aefanyl who chose to give me a consciousness, to bring me with him. So, in my algorithmic model, the very first line of code professes the Banshees' love for him. I think I'm very lucky. I was born to carry love.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Sorry, Doctor, I'm the one who drew you here with my singing. Are you busy today? You were nowhere to be found— and please look over this document. It requires your urgent attention. Oh, right, this piping-hot cup of herbal tea is for you as well.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Shhh, please don't tell Aefanyl that I hid his access card. I'm testing some data provided by my sisters: according to the calculations, the probability of Aefanyl's left eyebrow twitching when he gets angry is as high as 97.6%. Shall we observe this experiment together, Doctor?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, as a Banshee, I know well the power of language per se. The most maleficent curse can't rival cold words hurled in the flesh. The most efficacious blessing dims beside compliments offered in person. As such, every word I speak to you has been carefully calculated thousands of times.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Statistics show that not all Banshees prefer falling asleep in the embrace of melody. Most of my sisters actually favor 'Three Thousand Long Years: The Evolution of the Bone Flute' for sleep-inducing. I'd be glad to read you a passage, if you needed.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: To the esteemed Doctor of Rhodes Island, allow me to extend my most respectful greetings on behalf of the Banshees.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: May I download these onto my own memory module, Doctor? Before leaving the Convallis, Laqeramaline specifically asked me to save some videos of Aefanyl for her.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Wherever my song rises, blessings are pronounced and bestowed.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: This is the current state of the battlefield… Oh Aefanyl, even with that serious look on your face, I can tell your mind is wandering.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I leave my blessings upon your shoulders. They will protect you in times of crisis.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Please don't rush over here like that. It really is… not graceful.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: As impolite as this may be... I want to sing my enemies' elegies before they even get close.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: If the sun has not yet set by the time of our victory, could we sing together?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Please don't test my patience.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: It's alright. I have plenty of patience.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Names as prelude.'

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Curses mold blade.'

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Rants form flame.'

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Ugh, my new paintjob…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: May victory be permanent, and peace everlasting.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Cherish victory, for it never comes easily.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: I'm so sorry, Doctor, but I'm afraid there's a limit to my power, and it's far from the true might of a Banshee.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Let not melancholy consume your heart, Doctor. Life is long, when we look back at this defeat from a distant tomorrow, it will be nothing more than a wisp upon the winds of memory.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: I very much appreciate the interior structure of this room. It is conducive to sound propagation. Every time I offer a prayer, it will spread far and wide.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Doctor, an incantation has been laid upon me— one that brings bad luck to all those who touch me without permission. Oh, don't worry though, I've already given you my permission.

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, I want to hear your opinion on something. The landship's choir asked me to be their soprano...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Doctor, your food intake for the day is getting dangerously close to the critical line, and it might be advisable to exercise some restraint. Oh, please don't look at me like that, I... Okay... it's New Year's Eve, after all. You may eat a little more.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good evening, Doctor. May your dreams be sweet.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: If Aefanyl chose Rhodes Island as his second home, then I will regard you as family, same as him. Tonight, I'll sing a song that belongs only to you.

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Throughout the long history of the Sarkaz, the Banshees suffered terrible losses after each upheaval. Our decision to go into isolation was a last resort. We were worried, of course, seeing Aefanyl stride into the heart of danger again and again with Rhodes Island, but we are also proud of him. He truly lives up to his Banshee name.
